task.target: writable static state the types store does not cover, found by method rather than by reading a warning
task.scope: every written rip-relative target in the image, minus every range a STATIC/PTR/SLOTPTR/ARRAY route cell declares, clustered by proximity and ranked by writing bodies; then read the top clusters instead of counting them
